WITH status_tallies AS (
  SELECT 
    archstat,
    COUNT(DISTINCT arcref) as tally
  FROM scanqc
  GROUP BY archstat
),
total_tally AS (
  SELECT SUM(tally) as total FROM status_tallies
),
status_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    st.archstat,
    st.tally,
    st.tally::NUMERIC / tt.total as share
  FROM status_tallies st
  CROSS JOIN total_tally tt
),
average_share_calc AS (
  SELECT 
    AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM status_shares
)
SELECT 
  ss.archstat as status,
  ss.tally,
  ss.share,
  ss.share - asc.avg_share as above_average
FROM status_shares ss
CROSS JOIN average_share_calc asc
WHERE ss.share > asc.avg_share
ORDER BY ss.share DESC;
